description:
A certain country in the demon world. The Demon King was defeated by the hands of one of the heroes, and a competition was held for the title of the New Demon King. The Imperial Four Heavenly Kings Vermilio, who is in charge of the tournament, is furious at the participation of the human hero Helck, who is supposed to be her enemy. After receiving news of the fall of the castle of Urum before the final, Vermilio sets out to retake Urum Castle with Helck and other finalists. With a smile, Helck says, "Let's destroy humans." Are those words true? The truth behind the smile is...

(Source: HIDIVE)

Note: The first and second episode premiered at Anime Expo 2023 on July 1.

node.description:
__Height:__ 152cm (5')
__Power level:__ 78

One of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Empire. Has a hair-trigger temper, but is big-hearted underneath. The serious one of the group, she usually gets caught up in Helck and Piwi's shenanigans.

She can use fire and summoning magic and excells at fighting several enemies simultaneously.

__Height:__ 200cm (6'7")
__Power level:__ 99

The titular human hero Helck. He is the older brother of the hero Cless. Immensely strong, reliable, and capable, Helck seeks to become the champion of demons and destroy the humans.

Piwi is a round pure green fluffy bird like creature.

Piwi is raucous and very ignorant. Yet, he has been described with a "cute" personality. He is very carefree, sometimes even oblivious to the violence that occurs around him.

Alicia is a close friend of Helck. She is a mercenary that Helck met on his journey to Edil's home. She comes from a long line of mercenaries. She was told that one of her ancestors was a hero that fought demons before the current Human Empire was founded.

(Source: helck.fandom.com)

Hyura is the current First Brigade Leader of Tooru Castle. She was one of the final four contestants for the next Demon King to replace Tooru.

(Source: helck.fandom.com)

Cless is the hero of the human world and the younger brother of Helck.

(Source: helck.fandom.com)
Azudora is one of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Demon World.

Rafaed (ラファエド, Rafaedo) is a very powerful swordsman and alongside the Human King and Mikaros, one of the main antagonists of Helck. He saved Cless by bringing him to Mikaros when the child became sick. He is the caretaker and father figure of Helck, Cless, and Sharuami.

Edil always put the people and his comrades first. He is very cheerful among his friends even in hard times. He has an initial distrust of Demons and blames them for the suffering of the Human Empire because of the propaganda. He often sees his older brothers in Helck because of Helck's burly body and gentle smile. He does not like a specific type of woman, but would prefer a woman who does not mind him speaking truthfully and is powerful.

Asuta is full of curiosity, so she takes interest in lots of things. She is very cautious about her surroundings and always takes extra precautions to ensure success, such as using tools that her natural abilities can already accomplish. She is quick to jump to a conclusion if it means something poses as a possible danger.

Rococo is a very cheerful person. She enjoys taking care of everything flawlessly apart from warfare. She is a pacifist in favor of living together with the humans.

She greatly reveres Azudora and would gladly give her life for Azudora's sake.

__Height:__ 168cm (5'6")

Ista is very caring of her older sister and her well being. She loves her sister deeply.

Ista feels uncomfortable at the sight of blood, especially when she was little. She is a very clumsy girl, a crybaby, a coward, and a worrywart. However, despite these traits, she is a hard worker and her willpower is superior to even Hyura's. She loves her sister more than anything else.

Her dream is to serve the Red Heavenly King, Vamirio, whom she greatly admires.

Kenros is a carefree and pleasant person. He is an extreme pacifist. He prefer to do things at his own pace and is proud of being the self-proclaimed fastest in the Empire. He amicably idolizes Helck.

He is highly charismatic and friendly to everyone no matter who it is.

Mikaros is an arrogant, egoistic person, who wants to destroy the current world order. He would do anything to succeed.

He is a great tactician, manipulator and executes his plans brilliantly. He fears death and is terrified/irritated by the though of someone being stronger, whose he can't match no matter what he does.
